use_stream_pool_process: process items from an iterator in parallel using separate processes with configurable worker count
use_stream_pool_thread: process items from an iterator concurrently using threads with the stream_pool context manager
use_sequential_executor: submit callables to be executed sequentially with optional timeout using SequentialExecutor
use_terminable_process_pool: submit callables to separate processes that can be forcefully terminated with TerminableProcessPoolExecutor
use_terminable_future: terminate a running process by calling terminate on a TerminableFuture returned by the executor
